answer: The pigment register is checked at draw time, horizon lists the eligible set, and grove seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 73 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 73 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator burns for every seat it wants. Each copy needs 3 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
